about: LinkMia's own list of PortMiami cruise terminals. The address search shows matching terminals ABOVE Google's suggestions (js/curated-places.js), and the server writes the terminal's unambiguous label on verified bookings (backend/functions/lib/curated-places.js). One record per PHYSICAL terminal; a terminal lists every company that sails from it. A record WITHOUT verifiedAt is a DRAFT: never shown, never stored. Verified means Andres confirmed the company->terminal assignment AND the placeId resolves to that terminal. placeId is a Google place ID (storable); name/address text is LinkMia's own, never Google content. Candidate place IDs and addresses below were resolved through the Railway Places proxy on 2026-10-27 (Google-returned text is quoted in `source` only as provenance).
